reviews.title: As
reviews.text: When I tried to use it it led me to a ad and I couldn’t create my account so I couldn’t recite

reviews.title: Update blocking from reading the Quran
reviews.text: I’m honestly very frustrated with one thing: the app is now forcing me to update it before I can even open it. I just wanted to read the Qur’an, but I was blocked out completely unless I downloaded the latest update. That’s unacceptable. No one should ever be stopped from accessing the Book of Allah just because of a technical update.
It used to be free

reviews.title: Surah Kahf challenge
reviews.text: I really like this app as this really does encourage me to read the Quran more however I have mentioned this previously but the Friday Surah Kahf challenge finishes way too early. I don’t always have time to read the Quran at work so when I come home I look forward to finishing it off but the challenge is taken off when theirs atleast 1.5 hours left until maghrib in UK time. Please could this be fixed asap!

reviews.title: Subscription
reviews.text: I want to give this app 1 star because if you don’t pay for a subscription, you can’t access it. Why should I have to pay for the Quran? The Quran is priceless. Islam came for all of humanity, and I believe access to the Quran should be free for everyone. Charging people to access it doesn’t make sense to me at all.

reviews.title: Forcing us to pay now
reviews.text: I loved this app so much for so many years. Now they have a new update where they are forcing us to pay for the app. It’s quite ridiculous and upsetting. I even recommended it to other friends and I guess I’ll no longer be doing that. Quran reading should be free at least. If someone wants the rest of the features they provide, they can purchase them but that should not be the case for just reading the Quran. Highly disappointed.

reviews.title: Poor Management
reviews.text: I waited for 3 days for me to get approval to enter the app, i still didn’t get approval, and no follow-ups. I like the concept, that’s why i downloaded it, but if it makes me wait this long, i guess i’ll just use another app.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: As a developer myself if you are not going to offer a free option, remove it. It’s misleading. Was excited to start my Quran journey but have found more suitable free apps, that do not require the company to produce value on the build to justify the cost.

reviews.title: I’m so disappointed in you guys
reviews.text: I am currently not working so I clicked to  this app for free and gave a reasonable explanation and the admin denied me. This is one of the few Quran apps that I was so engaged in, tracking how many verses I read but I can’t do that anymore. Sadly you guys, lost another user and I will not be using this app ever again. Thank you, for the times you enabled me to use the Quranly app.

reviews.title: The app is unusable
reviews.text: Whenever I’m trying to login, it keeps on telling me subscription expired. It’s not letting me get past the page of paying for a subscription.

reviews.title: No communication or respond to email
reviews.text: I have emailed over 10 times to all your Emails begging for some help. No one responds. I have paid for life time sub yet I am still being forced to pay monthly or I lost my streak. This is very unfair. Please respond to my emails.

reviews.title: No WiFi always no connection it shows
reviews.text: Please check why it shows no WiFi no internet I can’t sign in for months

reviews.title: Good while it lasted
reviews.text: I have had a 530 days daily streak using Quranly, I like the interface, but since about a week now I have been locked out the app and my big streak of reading Quran through the app has been lost…. They are forcing me to pay for Quranly premium now…. I consider all new people to stay away from Quranly and just use a different app so you don’t get surprised and lose such a long streak like I have because they locked me out which is such a shame.

reviews.title: Weeks waiting for free pass because i cant afford it
reviews.text: what you guys are doing is haram wallah. what if someone cant afford it do they really have to wait weeks or even months for you guys to decide to give them the free pass? i get it theres other apps out here that are free but why when you guys can get the hasanat of these people reading quran? Thats my only problem i love this app wallah it gives me motivation to read more and more but things like this just don’t make sense wallah.

reviews.title: Sad
reviews.text: I’ve paid for this app for well over two years. At times the payment will come due and at that moment I don’t have funds (I live week to week) and I have been allowed to read for free for a few days until I get paid. This week, I didn’t have money and requested to read for free and was denied for the last several days. This tells me the creator cares about the money, not people being able to read the Quran. I won’t support greed. I will NOT renew on pay day. I’ll find another way to read the Quran. Greed ruins everything.

reviews.title: Forcing me to pay
reviews.text: What kind of inconsiderate app is this not allowing me to read the Quran if I don’t pay for a subscription, absolutely stupid and a whole money making scheme over something as important as the Quran, you should all be ashamed of yourselves and really re think what Islam is all about, a complete scam of an app

reviews.title: Purple Quran
reviews.text: Assalam Alakium to those who are reading this. January 15th I pre ordered the purple Quran, due to me being in America I payed about $40 when it’s originally $20. I reached out with an email to let them know to this day I have not received my purple Quran and no one has gotten back to me. I get the other emails about deals and the life time Quranly sale but no one has reached out. I am giving one star only for my experience with paying and ordering for the Purple Quran, other than that. The App is great and has helped me a lot with memorizing. InshaAllah, everything works out and that I’m able to receive the Quran I payed for.

reviews.title: Emotional blackmail
reviews.text: So after installing this app. It asked me to pay. For certain reason I cant. The message came its between you and Allah. I felt very bad I thought what if prophet Muhammad PBUH sold quran to sahaba. If the greed of money is that much rather do something else then this. Or simply ask for charity.

reviews.title: dark theme only darkens the translation not the actual Arabic
reviews.text: What’s the point of having a dark theme when it doesn’t darken the Arabic? Paying app should minimum have this kind of features. It’s hard to read for people with sensitive eyesight. Please address this issue, this is a bare minimum.

reviews.title: Pls respond
reviews.text: I normally use Quranly on my phone and on my iPad and recently I read up to a specific place on the Ramadan challenge on my phone I logged out and then when I went into my iPad on the Ramadan challenge it took me way behind.

reviews.title: Guilt tripping to subscriptions
reviews.text: Not a fan of this.

reviews.title: English translation
reviews.text: I’ve heard such amazing things about this app but as I only know English I used the English translation but it doesn’t make sense, I really hope someone can fix this

reviews.title: purple Quran not received
reviews.text: I ordered a purple Quran and they didn’t send it to me. Feel like I’ve been scammed.

reviews.title: Huge mistake in Ayats
reviews.text: I could download free quran apps but I believed on this 1 because i was sure its approved by mufti mink and made by muslim. However I dont think so they have looked into it properly. I was trying to read 4 qul which I know by heart anyways and they have major mistakes. Its not just 1 x mistake but whole Qul is almost wrong because of its zabar and zair mistakes. I am sure there will be many mistakes if i start comparing it word by word with Quran. Kindly. I beg you to correct these mistakes.

reviews.title: Not able to login
reviews.text: I’ve been trying to login with my apple id for the past few days, but It keeps loading and nothing happens afterwards!!

reviews.title: Cancelling my subscription
reviews.text: I had over 500 days on my streak I missed one day due to personal issues and they refused to give me back my streak . I have been paying and being consistent with this app for almost two years and this is what they do to me . They lost someone that was once a happy and loyal customer . Also customer service were very condescending and insensitive about the whole issue . Allah swt always gives us second chances when we repent but the owners of this app can’t even give me my streak back after  I missed for ONE DAY in over 500 DAYS ??? Make it make sense ??? Honestly they’re so weird for that .
